title: Rare-cancers: a computation-only research program for EWSR1::NR4A3 extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma — roadmap, artefacts and per-paper deposits
description:
A snapshot of the repository behind a continuously-maintained, computation-only research program targeting extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma (EMC), an ultra-rare sarcoma driven by the EWSR1::NR4A3 fusion. It holds the ranked route portfolio and its roadmap, the code and graded artefacts behind every route, and the manuscripts drawn from them. Routes carry an explicit decisive experiment and kill-criterion, and every result is generated from public data alone, with no wet lab.

This record archives the whole repository. Individual papers are deposited separately, each as its own Zenodo record carrying only the files its archive manifest names, so that a paper's availability statement cites a frozen archive rather than a moving snapshot. Cite this record's concept DOI for the project as a living document; cite a versioned DOI, or a paper's own deposit, when you need a fixed state.
